questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: A circle has center (h, k) and radius r. Use the Pythagorean Theorem to derive the equation satisfied by every point (x, y) on the circle. The diagram shows one example, with center C(2, 1).
questions.prompt_markup: A circle has center (h, k) and radius r. Use the Pythagorean Theorem to derive the equation satisfied by every point (x, y) on the circle. The diagram shows one example, with center C(2, 1).
questions.required_method: Draw the right triangle with legs |x - h| and |y - k| and hypotenuse r.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof (paragraph, two-column, or flow). Essential: a right triangle with horizontal leg |x - h|, vertical leg |y - k|, hypotenuse r (the distance CP); the Pythagorean Theorem gives (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r²; squaring removes the absolute values; the reasoning holds for every point on the circle (degenerate legs of length 0 included). Invalid: only checking the one example point.
